kind: Controlled weather and elevation; real animation time and unmodified randomness. Chromium desktop / emulated phone, not physical-device acceptance.
videoNote: Continuous videos include setup and reloads. Frame seconds are relative to the final observation start (ISO timestamp), not video start.
traceNote: Summaries use every captured frame; stored traces are sampled every fifth frame plus event endpoints.

live.kind: Natural live-time observation: no URL, weather, clock or random overrides. Browser cache cleared and fixed source verified before observation.

cacheNote: An earlier live-context run served the cached pre-fix ambient.js and reproduced the original defect. It is excluded. The accepted live run cleared the browser cache, disabled caching and verified the fixed source before observation.
